title: Read later pages of Rayuela message trays
notes: A read-only GET through the existing Rayuela menu returned records 201-400 and 401-443 with distinct row IDs using the portal offset. The bundled attachment request is tracked separately by the related task.
done_when: The CLI can read a requested later page, rejects a mismatched or past-end response, and preserves the default and since-ID behavior.
result: Read later pages of Rayuela message trays
evidence: After pnpm build, the live CLI read pages 1, 2 and 3 of the inbox as 200, 200 and 43 rows, all dated, with 443 unique IDs and the same total. The command refused page 4. Focused tests verify the since-ID filter on a later page, reject incorrect or incomplete ranges and preserve the first-page call.
